name: Middle East
overview: From our headquarters in the Dubai, we command unmatched technical depth across the GCC and wider Levant. As Gulf economies rapidly diversify and establish modern tax architectures, we guide corporate groups through the interconnected tax landscapes of the UAE, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, and Kuwait.

keyCities.name: Manama
keyCities.focus: Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax & Financial Services

strategicRelevance: The GCC is witnessing unprecedented tax convergence with corporate tax laws in the UAE and Bahrain, aggressive ZATCA transfer pricing audits in Saudi Arabia, and regional BEPS implementation.

name: Asia-Pacific
overview: The India-UAE and broader APAC-Middle East economic corridors represent some of the world's most dynamic investment routes. Taxmetryx provides strategic cross-border tax advisory for Indian multinational groups expanding into the UAE, Singapore-based regional headquarters, and East Asian conglomerates navigating CEPA trade agreements.
strategicRelevance: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the UAE and India has multiplied bilateral trade and investment, requiring synchronized transfer pricing policies and Place of Effective Management (POEM) mitigation.

name: Europe
overview: European multinationals and family offices maintain extensive commercial and investment bridges with the UAE. We collaborate with leading independent European tax practices to deliver seamless advice on bilateral tax treaties, Anti-Tax Avoidance Directives (ATAD), EU Blacklist compliance, and Pillar Two GloBE rules across London, Switzerland, and continental Europe.

keyCities.name: London
keyCities.focus: UK-UAE DTAA, Non-Dom Transition & Fund Structures

strategicRelevance: With European jurisdictions actively scrutinizing substance and economic nexus under ATAD 3 and BEPS 2.0, our defensible UAE substance architectures ensure treaty access and eliminate aggressive withholding tax leakage.
